title: The Umpire's Decision — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational cricket philosophy 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The umpire raises one finger slowly toward the sky
And everyone within a hundred metres wants to know why
The batsman stares at a point somewhere beyond the boundary rope
The umpire has no doubt about it and gives the batsman no hope

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El árbitro levanta un dedo hacia el cielo
[The umpire raises one finger toward the sky]
Una decisión que no admite apelación ni consuelo
[A decision that admits no appeal or comfort]
El bateador mira más allá de la línea de fondo
[The batsman looks beyond the boundary line]
El árbitro sabe y su dedo es el fondo
[The umpire knows and his finger is the bottom line]

[Chorus — English]
The umpire's decision is final — this is known
Whatever argument you're making, make it on your own
The umpire's decision comes from somewhere deep inside
The umpire has been watching every ball and has decided
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
L'arbitre lève un doigt — le verdict est rendu
[The umpire raises a finger — the verdict is given]
Peu importe si tu crois avoir battu
[It doesn't matter if you think you beat it]
Sa décision vient d'une vie entière de cricket
[His decision comes from a lifetime of cricket]
Et le doigt levé dit tout sans un seul ticket
[And the raised finger says everything without a single ticket]

[Outro — All three languages]
Umpire knows… El árbitro sabe… L'arbitre sait
The finger is final — El dedo es definitivo — Le doigt est définitif
That's my boy
